purpose: Teach: 主席/報復/紫外線/盗聴/衰え/反抗/自閉症/射撃

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学部主席卒業者の追跡を医療チームでも調べております
lines.en: Ren — we've been tracking the career paths of our medical school's top graduates through our healthcare team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady vocal tone, measured pace. Even delivery without condescension. The confidence of someone who has delivered this information many times before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感情の報復から起こる心理疾患、貴院、研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has researched how emotional trauma can trigger psychological conditions, then?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity rising at the end. Careful, respectful tone — Ren testing his understanding and the doctor's expertise. Slightly hesitant, as if weighing his words before speaking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、紫外線対策を医療チームでも啓発しております
lines.en: Yes. Our team has also been working on public awareness campaigns around UV protection.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact continuation. Slight warmth beneath the professional surface. The tone of someone confirming one item on a list before moving to the next. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療盗聴の防止策、貴院、進めておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is taking steps to prevent medical information breaches, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle observation rather than question. Ren's voice rises slightly at the end but stays soft. He's noticing, processing aloud. A little awed by the scope of the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、骨密度の衰えに関する研究も医療チームは行っております
lines.en: Yes. We're also conducting research on bone density decline as our population ages.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Brief pause before continuing, like checking a mental list. Steady and unhurried. The voice of someone accustomed to discussing medical concerns.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 反抗期のお子さんの心のケアも、貴院、お得意ですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is particularly skilled at supporting adolescents through difficult phases, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft recognition in the voice. Ren's respect showing through as genuine appreciation. Careful phrasing — he's seen this work and is acknowledging it quietly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、自閉症の支援を医療チームでも力を入れています
lines.en: Yes. We put significant effort into autism support and intervention programs.
lines.style: Steady, assured tone. Slight emphasis on 'significant' — pride in the work without boasting. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 射撃事故の救急対応、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has handled emergency response for traumatic accidents like shootings, then?
lines.style: Voice quieter now, more careful. Respect deepening. Ren is asking about something heavier, and his tone reflects that gravity. Trailing slightly downward at the close.
